ExploreDesc.SourceString: 遍布世界各地的传送装置，由「环」的直属机关「尤克阿什庭」负责管理。在海特洛市的街头传说中，废弃的红色电话亭里有时会传出诡异的铃声，无辜的过路人就这样消失在茫茫黑雾中……当然，都市传说总是存在一些美好的艺术加工，不过体验过的异能者们多次向「环」提议改良传送方式，毕竟被吞食，消化，然后再排……咳咳，反刍，总之是很糟糕的体验。「尤克阿什庭」暂未回复。
ExploreDesc.LocalizedString: Teleportation devices, scattered across the globe and managed by the Circle's direct agency, the Yggash Court. There is an urban legend in the streets of Hethereau about an abandoned red Phone Booth that sometimes emits a spooky ringtone, and just like that, innocent passersby vanish into the vast black fog… Of course, urban legends always have a bit of artistic flair to them. However, those who have experienced teleportation have repeatedly suggested to the Circle that they improve the method. After all, being swallowed, digested, and then… ahem, regurgitated, is quite an unpleasant experience. The Yggash Court has yet to respond.

ExploreGoal.SourceString: 激活该区域的ReroRero电话亭
ExploreGoal.LocalizedString: Activate the ReroRero Phone Booth in this area

ExploreDesc.SourceString: 由「环」各大部门共同建立的巨大建筑，可监测当地的维特海默值波动，并在数值异常时立刻发出警示，以便各部门及时采取应对措施。因其绚丽的外观和地标性，现已成为各大城市的热门打卡点。
ExploreDesc.LocalizedString: The Circle’s many departments built massive structures like this. They monitor local Wertheimer Index fluctuations and issue timely Anomaly warnings. Their striking design has made them landmarks and popular attractions in major cities.

ExploreGoal.SourceString: 激活该区域的维特海默塔
ExploreGoal.LocalizedString: Activate the Wertheimer Tower in this area

ExploreDesc.SourceString: 不知前路、难以落地的盲目乌鸦衔着的宝石，无人知晓它们来自何方。有传言说捡到「谕石」的人会被厄运缠身，倘若不小心捡到也不用在意，位于各地的魔女之家中的「魔女」小姐能够消弭这份厄运。
ExploreDesc.LocalizedString:
Gems, carried by blind, lost ravens that are unable to land, their origins unknown to all.
Rumors say that those who pick up Oracle Stones will be struck by misfortune… Though, don't worry if you happen to find one; the mysterious lady from the Witch's House can dispel your misfortune.

ExploreDesc.SourceString:
靠近「待收容异象」至一定距离后，小地图会自动开启雷达标识。
当距离不断缩短，雷达的颜色也会发生改变，由远即近分别为：蓝色→绿色→橙色→红色。
ExploreDesc.LocalizedString:
When approaching an Anomaly Awaiting Containment, the radar marker on the mini-map will activate automatically .
The radar's indicator will change from blue to green, then to orange, and ultimately to red as the distance decreases.

ExploreGoal.SourceString: 完成该区域的异象委托
ExploreGoal.LocalizedString: Complete the Anomaly Commissions in this area

ExploreDesc.SourceString:
掩藏黑渊中的罪孽终将得到彼岸的审判，成为吾主吧，只需要写下……你的名字。你的名字是？你的名字是？你的名字是？你的名字是？你的名字是？你的名字是？你的名字是？
「你的名字是？」
ExploreDesc.LocalizedString:
The sins hidden in the dark abyss will finally face judgment from the other shore. To become my master, you need only write… your… name. What is your name? What is your name? What is your name? What is your name? What is your name? What is your name? What is your name?
"What is your name?"

ExploreGoal.SourceString: 击败黑之书
ExploreGoal.LocalizedString: Defeat Black Tome

ExploreDesc.SourceString:
只有深夜才会出现，骑着一台黑色摩托机车游荡于都市街头的无头骑士。据说会盯上时速超高的飙车族，与其进行竞速比赛并在胜利后用可怖的镰刀收割他们的暴走之魂。
「刺骨的蓝火会燃尽一切热血。」
ExploreDesc.LocalizedString:
A headless rider that appears only in the dead of night, roaming the city streets on a black motorcycle. Legend says it targets high-speed street racers, challenging them to races and harvesting their reckless psyches with a terrifying scythe after victory.
"Bone-chilling blue flames will burn away all passion."

ExploreGoal.SourceString: 击败无首铁驭
ExploreGoal.LocalizedString: Defeat Headless Rider

ExploreDesc.SourceString:

「叱骂反调，为寂然无声，一言之庭。」
ExploreDesc.LocalizedString:
A silent boy, who had shut his heart, wandered into a greenhouse poisoned by the malice of words. Vines took root in his flesh and blood, drawing sustenance and weaving cocoons of flowers. From this, his unspoken words transformed into the shapes of all things.
"Scolding and discord become silent stillness, a garden of words."

ExploreGoal.SourceString: 击败塞润尼缇

ExploreDesc.SourceString:

「恭喜，你在本次挑战中获得了99个完美以及1个很好。」
ExploreDesc.LocalizedString:
Follow the beat, press buttons when the time is right… And there you have it! You are now a rhythm gamer!
"Congratulations, you achieved 99 Perfects and 1 Great in this challenge."

ExploreGoal.SourceString: 击败音霸魔王

ExploreDesc.SourceString:

「歌声是它的呼救。」
ExploreDesc.LocalizedString:
Within this Anomalous Realm, a massive whale is bound by chains from a whaling ship. Suffering, the whale searches for someone powerful enough to help destroy its bindings.
"Its song is a cry for help."

ExploreGoal.SourceString: 击败海囚

ExploreDesc.SourceString:

「不要夺走我的孩子……」
ExploreDesc.LocalizedString:
The mother bird that nests in the shadows calls out to lost hatchlings with a gentle, loving female chirp, asking if they would like to become her hatchlings. Should they agree, they will remain in the bird's nest forever.
"Don't take my hatchlings away from me…"

ExploreGoal.SourceString: 击败囿巢鸟

ExploreDesc.SourceString:

「逃走吧，能逃走吗？」
ExploreDesc.LocalizedString:
A clumsy, massive butterfly, clinging to movie ticket stubs plastered across its body. Forever trying to soar into the sky, yet wandering endlessly in this wretched place, day after day.
"Must escape… Can I?"

ExploreDesc.SourceString:
这世间异象林林总总——
有些已被记录，有些尚待发掘。
有些是真相的全貌，有些只是管中窥豹。

人们再怎么努力收集，档案永远缺几页。
不是疏忽，是有些东西还没来得及被归类，就已经在不起眼的角落里自行长出了枝叶。

你若在途中抬头，偶然瞥见那枝叶，不妨采撷一枝。
也不枉这场相逢的奇妙。
ExploreDesc.LocalizedString:
The world is full of Anomalies of every kind—
some have been recorded, while others still wait to be found.
Some reveal the whole truth; others offer only a narrow glimpse.

No matter how hard people try to collect them all, the archive is always missing a few pages.
Not out of negligence. Some things take root in forgotten corners before anyone has time to classify them.

If, on your journey, you happen to look up and catch sight of such a branch, pluck it.
Then this curious encounter will not have been in vain.
